ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 75% high-intensity (white) pixels and 25% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white contiguous zones across both lobes. Dark pigmentation originates at the peduncle insertion, extending in a 'V' shape towards the notch and along the trailing edges. Three distinct, roughly parallel dark vertical streaks located on the distal portion of the right lobe. Dark margins along the leading edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 65-70 degrees; depth is clearly defined against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge displays low-amplitude, high-frequency irregular undulations. Right lobe trailing edge displays higher-amplitude, jagged serrations with prominent peaks and deeper valleys near the mid-lobe section.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory on the leading edges toward the tips; trailing edges exhibit a generally convex curve from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense cluster of circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters (barnacles) located on the extreme distal tip of the left lobe. Smaller, scattered white spots visible along the margin of the right lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple vertical and sub-vertical dark linear pixel disruptions. Three prominent, parallel linear marks on the distal right lobe. Several thinner, less aligned marks on the left lobe central area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Active barnacle colonization on the left distal tip and trailing edge. Significant irregular jaggedness/potential minor tissue loss on the right lobe trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct 'hook' or 'J' shaped dark pigmentation mark in the lower-left inner quadrant of the fluke surface.
